node: Sulphur and sulphuric acid feedstock for copper, nickel HPAL, and fertilizers
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one obvious copper reference name and three more underfollowed or second-order US-listed exposures tied to sulphuric-acid production, procurement, or fertilizer input sensitivity. The strongest underfollowed candidate is Nexa Resources because it is a NYSE-listed zinc smelter with sulphuric-acid byproduct exposure. Itafos is a more speculative OTCQX discovery candidate because its Conda phosphate operation has explicit sulphuric-acid dependence and a recently amended Rio Tinto Kennecott supply contract. Mosaic is a larger but still node-relevant fertilizer customer whose phosphate margins may be sensitive to sulphur and sulphuric-acid costs. Southern Copper is included only as a high-attention reference anchor because it produces sulphuric acid and operates SX-EW copper assets, but its mega-cap status makes it less suitable for the underfollowed lane.
